self_introduction.title: Software Engineer · Backend & Agentic AI
self_introduction.description:
I am Cyril Deschamps, a software engineer (Polytech Montpellier graduate) specialised in backend development and agentic AI. I work at Ledger in the blockchain industry, where I built a continuous differential testing engine and, during my internship, optimised a JsonRPC streaming proxy (×16 user capacity, −40% memory). I build AI-powered tools using LangChain and work across the full stack with Scala, TypeScript, and React.
Good conversations are always welcome.

bullets: Continuous differential testing engine comparing APIs and alerting on diffs, used as the verification step of an automated harness loop converging toward full parity
JsonRPC streaming proxy: ×16 user capacity, −40% memory footprint
Added WebSocket support to the proxy
Co-authored a proposal for AI-powered knowledge management across engineering projects
Full rewrite of the test management application
SDING — agentic AI brainstorming tool with LangChain (SCAMPER, IBM Design Thinking)
SimplX — cross-platform app on Android & iOS for 100+ employees
Pluricité — real-time multiplayer game Top Ten Pro via WebSockets
Specialisation in software engineering and project management
